status: Initialization complete. No prior work detected. Task requires implementing 7 independent targets for a Go GUI toolkit. All targets are additive (no breaking changes). Key requirements saved to knowledge bank focusing on precise specifications, field names, types, file paths, and behavioral details that are easy to misinterpret.

knowledge.content: Target 1 (App Metadata): AppMetadata struct goes in root fyne package (app.go) with exact fields: ID string, Name string, Version string, Build int, Icon Resource. Default values when no metadata set: ID: "com.example", Name: "Fyne App", Version: "1.0.0", Build: 1.
Target 1 (App Metadata): SetMetadata function must be in app sub-package at app/meta.go, signature: SetMetadata(m fyne.AppMetadata). App.Metadata() method returns AppMetadata (not pointer).

Target 2 (JSON Theme): Hex color parsing must support 3, 4, 6, 8 digits with or without # prefix. Special case: 3-digit expands each digit (abc → aabbcc), 4-digit includes alpha (abcd → aabbccdd). Invalid format returns transparent color with error.

Target 2 (JSON Theme): Color resolution order is critical - check variant-specific colors first (Colors-dark or Colors-light based on current variant), then generic Colors map, then default theme fallback.

Target 3 (Data Binding): NewSprintf goes in data/binding/sprintf.go. Special handling for Set(): Bytes type cannot be round-tripped (returns error), URI type parsed via storage.ParseURI. Get() returns error if any source had error during last DataChanged.
Target 3 (Data Binding): StringToStringWithFormat optimization - if format is "%s" (identity), return original binding directly without wrapping. Otherwise delegate to NewSprintf.

Target 4 (Menu): Menu.Refresh() must refresh windows displaying this Menu AND also refresh system tray menu if this menu is set as tray menu. MainMenu.Refresh() only affects windows with this MainMenu.

Target 5 (Toolbar): Constructor return types must change from ToolbarItem interface to concrete types: NewToolbarAction returns *ToolbarAction, NewToolbarSpacer returns *ToolbarSpacer, NewToolbarSeparator returns *ToolbarSeparator.
Target 6 (Container): Container.RemoveAll() sets Objects to nil (not empty slice). Container.Add() must be nil-safe - passing nil is a no-op, nil not appended to Objects.

Target 6 (Entry): SetMinRowsVisible affects multi-line entries only. Default is 3 rows. Method stores count internally, MinSize() calculation uses this count when greater than 0. Count of 2 makes shorter, 5 makes taller than default.

Target 6 (Validation): NewAllStrings goes in data/validation/all.go, signature: NewAllStrings(validators ...fyne.StringValidator) fyne.StringValidator. Returns first error encountered, or nil if all pass. Runs validators in order.
Target 6 (Hyperlink): OnTapped func() field on Hyperlink struct. When OnTapped is non-nil, call it instead of opening URL. When nil, preserve existing URL-opening behavior.

Target 7 (Desktop App): desktop.App interface goes in driver/desktop/app.go with two methods: SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu) and SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource). Note: menu parameter is pointer to fyne.Menu.
